_about: Known advisories assessed as not exploitable here, or accepted until a named fix. tools/dependency_audit.py fails CI on any advisory not listed, and on any entry past its review_by date. Changing this file is a security decision: say why in the commit.

exceptions.title: Prototype Pollution in sheetJS
exceptions.assessment: APPLIES in the browser when a user opens a workbook in the Studio mapping preview. Fixed builds are published only at cdn.sheetjs.com, which this build environment cannot reach. Fix: install https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz from a machine that can, and commit the lockfile.

exceptions.title: SheetJS Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
exceptions.assessment: APPLIES client-side only (a user's own browser tab). Same fix as GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6.
